title: Heart failure: end-stage, assist device and acute
question: Assign the ICD-10-CM codes for the patient's heart failure and any heart assist device.
note:
Chief Complaint
Shortness of breath and increased swelling in the lower extremities.

HPI
The patient is an 89-year-old female presenting for a follow-up visit regarding a new diagnosis of acute diastolic heart failure. She reports that she experienced a first episode of significant shortness of breath and fluid retention over the past two weeks. She denies any prior history of heart failure. She has been started on a diuretic regimen and is being monitored for symptom improvement and weight changes. She reports improved breathing since beginning the medication but notes continued mild swelling in her ankles.

Medication List
Furosemide 40mg daily.

Exam
The patient appears in no acute distress. Vital signs are stable. Chest is clear to auscultation. Heart sounds are regular with no murmurs. Lower extremities show 1+ pitting edema bilaterally.

Assessment
Acute diastolic heart failure, first episode.

Plan
Continue current diuretic dosage. The patient will monitor her daily weight and report any increase of more than 2 pounds in a 24-hour period. Follow-up will occur in one week to assess fluid status.

Electronically signed, P. O'Brien, MD, 05/14/2026
explanations: A first, acute episode of diastolic heart failure: I50.31 (HCC 225).

distractors.why: There is no chronic heart failure: this is the first episode.

hccs.label: Acute Heart Failure (Excludes Acute on Chronic)
